player.name: Player
player.summary: Bet that the Player hand finishes closer to 9. Even money; a tie pushes.
player.howItWorks:
You bet before the deal. If the **Player** hand ends with the higher total, you win 1 to 1: bet $10, win $10.

If the Banker wins, you lose the bet. On a **tie** your bet **pushes**: it comes back, with no win and no loss.

The name is just the name of the hand. You are not the Player, and you never make a decision once the cards are out.
player.tip: The second-cheapest bet on the table. Banker is a little cheaper, even after its commission.

banker.name: Banker
banker.summary: Bet that the Banker hand finishes closer to 9. Pays 1 to 1 less 5% commission; a tie pushes.
banker.howItWorks:
You bet before the deal. If the **Banker** hand ends with the higher total, you win 1 to 1 **less 5% commission**: a $20 win pays $19. Commission is charged only on wins.

If the Player wins, you lose the bet. On a **tie** your bet **pushes** and comes back.

The Banker acts last, after seeing whether the Player drew, so it wins a little more often. The commission takes most of that advantage back, but not all of it.

In **EZ Baccarat** there is no commission, but a Banker win with a three-card 7 pushes. In **Super 6** there is no commission, but a Banker win on a total of 6 pays only 1 to 2 (half).
banker.tip: The lowest-edge bet on a standard table. Bet in $20 steps and the commission is always a round $1 per $20.

tie.name: Tie
tie.summary: Bet that both hands end on the same total. Pays 8 to 1, and loses when either hand wins.
tie.howItWorks:
You bet before the deal. If both hands finish on the **same total**, the Tie bet wins 8 to 1: a $5 Tie bet wins $40, and your $5 comes back too.

If either hand wins, the Tie bet loses. Player and Banker bets on the same hand simply push.

Some tables pay **9 to 1** on a Tie (the `tiePays` setting). It is still much dearer than Player or Banker.
tie.tip: 8 to 1 sounds generous, but a tie comes up less often than once in nine hands. Check the EV sheet before you bet it.

player-pair.name: Player Pair
player-pair.summary: A side bet that the Player's first two cards are the same rank. Pays 11 to 1.
player-pair.howItWorks:
Wins when the Player's **first two cards** have the same rank: Q-Q yes, Q-K no, and suits don't matter. Pays 11 to 1. Anything else loses, whoever wins the hand.

You can place it with or without a main bet.

banker-pair.name: Banker Pair
banker-pair.summary: A side bet that the Banker's first two cards are the same rank. Pays 11 to 1.
banker-pair.howItWorks:
Wins when the Banker's **first two cards** have the same rank: Q-Q yes, Q-K no, and suits don't matter. Pays 11 to 1. Anything else loses, whoever wins the hand.

You can place it with or without a main bet.

dragon-bonus-player.name: Dragon Bonus (Player)
dragon-bonus-player.summary: A side bet that pays more the more the Player wins by.
dragon-bonus-player.howItWorks:
Pays when the **Player** wins:

- **with a natural**: 1 to 1;
- **without a natural**, by 9 points: 30 to 1; by 8: 10 to 1; by 7: 6 to 1; by 6: 4 to 1; by 5: 2 to 1; by 4: 1 to 1.

A **natural tie** pushes. Anything else loses, including a win by 1 to 3 points without a natural.

dragon-bonus-banker.name: Dragon Bonus (Banker)
dragon-bonus-banker.summary: A side bet that pays more the more the Banker wins by.
dragon-bonus-banker.howItWorks:
Pays when the **Banker** wins:

- **with a natural**: 1 to 1;
- **without a natural**, by 9 points: 30 to 1; by 8: 10 to 1; by 7: 6 to 1; by 6: 4 to 1; by 5: 2 to 1; by 4: 1 to 1.

A **natural tie** pushes. Anything else loses, including a win by 1 to 3 points without a natural.

The paytable is the same as the Player version, but the Banker's big wins are rarer, so this side costs much more.

dragon-7.name: Dragon 7
dragon-7.summary: EZ Baccarat only: the Banker wins with a three-card 7. Pays 40 to 1.
dragon-7.howItWorks:
Offered only at **EZ Baccarat** tables. Wins when the **Banker wins with a total of 7 made with three cards**. Pays 40 to 1. Anything else loses.

That same hand is the one where an EZ Banker bet **pushes** instead of winning: it is how EZ tables earn their money without a commission.

panda-8.name: Panda 8
panda-8.summary: EZ Baccarat only: the Player wins with a three-card 8. Pays 25 to 1.
panda-8.howItWorks: Offered only at **EZ Baccarat** tables. Wins when the **Player wins with a total of 8 made with three cards**. Pays 25 to 1. Anything else loses.
